product_brief: Akamai behavior enabling Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) for TLS 1.3 Client to Edge communications.
pqc_capability_description: Supports Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) for transport layer security (TLS) communications. Accepts ML-KEM based hybrid key exchange. Applies to Enhanced TLS hostnames with TLS 1.3 enabled. Can be enabled/disabled per configuration.
pqc_roadmap_details: Aligns with industry standard; accepts ML-KEM based hybrid key exchange.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Can be disabled if high latency or increased error rate is observed. Risk of bypassing PQC if multiple hostnames share a single TLS certificate but PQC is only enabled for a subset.

product_brief: A global CDN and edge security platform providing fast, personalized digital experiences and robust encryption.
pqc_capability_description: Fastly is rolling out support for ML-KEM (Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism), a NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptography algorithm, across its global CDN fleet starting April 2025. It integrates with TLS v1.3 for post-quantum key exchange, offering backward compatibility with existing TLS implementations.
key_management_model: TLS key exchange using ML-KEM for post-quantum security; backward compatible with existing TLS implementations.
architecture_type: Global CDN fleet, Edge Compute, Cloud-native
target_industries: Streaming Media, Digital Publishing, eCommerce, Financial Services, High Tech, Travel & Hospitality, Online Education, Gaming, iGaming
pqc_roadmap_details: Rolling out ML-KEM support across the global CDN fleet starting April 2025 to meet upcoming post-quantum cryptography compliance requirements.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Backward compatible with existing TLS implementations; no required action for customers using TLS v1.3.

product_brief: CDN with hybrid post-quantum TLS support for client-to-edge connections.
pqc_capability_description: Hybrid post-quantum key establishment across all existing TLS security policies. Automatically enabled for client-to-edge connections. Available in all CloudFront edge locations. No customer configuration required.
financial_&_business_impact: No additional charges for using PQC or the TLS1.3_2025 policy.
